title: Chapter 200
text:
"How do you feel?"

Number One opened his eyes. His eyes had been modified. His pupils flashed with red light, and his vision could zoom in and out like a sniper scope. He looked down at his metal-skinned palms and moved his fingers.

"Better than ever."

Number One swung his fist, and the exoskeleton hummed. He smashed a hole in the steel wall. His hideous smile gradually widened and finally turned into a maniacal laugh.

After enduring endless pain, he finally obtained supernatural power.

The surging confidence intoxicated him.

In front of this power, Number One suddenly realized that Zero, who had killed him before, was just a weak little chick that could be crushed easily.

They were no longer on the same level.

"Zero, before I find you, don't die in the hands of others." Number One's eyes were ferocious as he muttered to himself, "You're mine."

…

Cyberlos walked out of the lab and reported to the leader.

"Due to the early schedule, the experiment is not mature yet. Only Number One can survive all the modifications. He's the only completely modified body," Cyberlos said. "It's hard to imagine that he can withstand all the torture."

The leader's tone was indifferent. "He died in Zero's hands. Hatred made his will indestructible."

"About Zero …" Cyberlos narrowed his eyes. "If he really has the ability to foresee, we have to get rid of him before the war. Otherwise, our strategic deployment will be exposed."

"He's like a rat in the sewer, hiding too deep."

The leader folded his hands and made a decision. "Activate Destiny's Child and find his location."

Cyberlos smiled. He had always been very interested in Destiny's Child.

The two walked through the twisting corridors and passed through the gates that required more and more authority. The security here was very tight. Teams of elite Night Owls patrolled the corridors, and their footsteps were orderly. There was a well-hidden secret room here.

The leader came to the door and entered the password. Then, it was fingerprint identification. He took off the gloves he had been wearing, revealing his palms. Hideous scars covered his palms as if they had been bitten by wild beasts.

There were also scars on his fingertips. After the identification, the leader put the gloves back on. The metal door moved and slid to the side. Only the leader had the authority to open this door.

Inside was a hibernation pod. A man with a metal mask on his face was lying in the pod hibernating. The nutrient solution ensured that his body would not die.

The leader operated the hibernation pod and injected the awakening potion. The pod door opened, and the man slowly opened his eyes. His eyes were like a pool of stagnant water, and he didn't care whether he was asleep or awake.

This person was known as the "Child of Destiny" by the Germinal Organization. He had a special ability to influence the future through language. Even the Germinal Organization did not know the details.

The leader waved his hand behind him, and his subordinate handed over Zero's file. The leader showed it page by page. Destiny's Child's gaze did not change as he flipped through the pages.

After flipping through it once, the leader repeated it again and said in a deep voice, "Let him show himself."

Destiny's Child finally blinked.

The leader took out a special key and opened the Child of Destiny's metal mask.

Destiny's Child closed his eyes. After a full five minutes, he opened his eyes and slowly said in a hoarse voice, "He will walk right into the trap and come here."

The leader's breathing paused. "Time."

"Not too long."

"I hope it works this time." Cyberlos shook his head. Destiny's Child's ability would not succeed every time. The smaller the requirement, the higher the success rate.

The leader put on the metal mask for Destiny's Child and pushed him back into the pod to sleep again.

The guards outside the door carefully poked their heads out and looked at each other in confusion.

Why are the leader and Mr. Cyberlos talking to themselves in the air?

…

After staying in the last novice village in the Western Continent for three days, Han Xiao could not wait to board the plane and leave. His next stop was the Northern Continent.

The average level of the players was getting closer to LV 20, and Han Xiao had to speed up his journey.

The sky was full of stars outside the porthole, and the plane flew in the dark clouds. After setting the route, it flew steadily.

In the night sky, the galaxy was bright, and it was reflected in Han Xiao's mirror-like eyes, bright and magnificent.

Looking at the night sky, Han Xiao would always think of those shining stars, countless civilizations built, and countless opportunities in the depths of the universe. It was extremely lively.

Han Xiao knew this very well. Every time he thought of it, he would feel a surge of ambition.

"The journey of a man is the sea of stars."

He had already gained a foothold in the Blue Star, and this was the starting point. The more trump cards he accumulated here, the more confident he would be.

Opening the interface, Han Xiao counted his gains.

After staying in the Western Continent for more than ten days, he had obtained a bunch of potions. One of them was a semi-finished potion with unknown effects, but it might be very valuable. He had also gained more connections, such as Dion, two superheroes with unknown uses, Hannes, and the others. He had also triggered a hidden main storyline.

He had also created the mechanical suit, Viper Modification.

Viper Modification could greatly increase his Strength and Agility attributes, making up for the weakness of a Mechanic in the early stages. In Han Xiao's mind, Viper Modification was the second battle plan, and it was still in its early stages. He still had to add new modules to the mechanical suit to increase its combat capabilities.

The sniper style was for assassination, kiting, and concealment. Viper Modification was for Han Xiao to fight head-on. In fact, he had already come up with a few modifications in his mind.

The biggest gain was the EXP and money from the four novice villages. [Energy Training Technique] was selling like hot cakes. Just as Han Xiao had expected, the profit it brought him was astronomical!

120,000,000 EXP!

Over 100,000,000 EXP!

Those who could afford the [Energy Training Technique] were all players who grew faster. Not everyone could afford it.

On the other hand, the Class Advancement Knowledge and Basic Skills were the most popular, and they were worth an additional 20,000,000 Experience Points!

The EXP accumulated on the interface was 140,000,000 EXP!

Looking at the long string of zeros, Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. Even for players of the same level, this amount of EXP was still an astronomical figure. Some players might not even reach this amount of EXP in the entire Version 1.0.

"Awesome." Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. For a long time in the future, he would not need to worry about EXP.

As long as he could solve the two big hurdles of Class Advancement and Class Advancement, his level would increase exponentially. He could also level up his skills freely. It would not take much effort for him to level up all his skills except for the blueprints. Most importantly, he could fuse blueprints in large batches to fill up his inventory.

Not only did he gain EXP, but he also earned 3,600,000 Aquamarine Dollars from [Energy Training Technique]. He also sold five recommendation letters, which added up to 4,850,000 EXP, replenishing his wallet.

"This trip was worth it!"

Han Xiao rubbed his hands and opened the interface eagerly.

The skills that were not maxed out (except for the blueprints) were [Grappling Lv.5], [Precision Shooting Lv.3], [Special Combat Lv.1], [Stealth Lv.1], [Aim While Holding Your Breath Lv.1], [Night Attack Lv.1], [Precision Enhancement Lv.4], [Energy Electromagnetic Enhancement Lv.1], [Precision Repair Lv.1], and [Pickpocket Lv.1].

He did not even look at the EXP requirement and directly leveled up all his skills except the blueprints!

Inhuman!

Your Precision Shooting has reached Lv.5. Your Sniping has reached Lv.5. You have learned [Field Control Vision].

Your Grappling has reached Lv.5. Your Special Combat has reached Lv.5. You have learned [Deadly Critical Strike].

You have gained the talent [Combat Expertise].

You have gained the talent [Shooting Expertise].
